entity_raw.name_raw: Servant in the House of Truth
entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Adventure Path #139: The Dead Roads
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your creator was a scholar and a seeker of lore, and your memories are filled with the feel of papyrus and ink.

Prerequisite(s): Shabti.

Benefit(s): Whenever you attempt a check for a Knowledge skill in which you have ranks, you can roll the check twice and use the better of the two results.
